primary: all 57 official req_comparison=true, answer_from=table, answer_type=span and singleton answer, out of TAT-QA DEV
control: all 114 other table-source singleton span questions in DEV. Do not supply req_comparison or membership to either policy. Report per subset and all.
inputs: Question, rows incl headers and same model answer if fallback. No gold, mappings, reference type or subset identity at method inference.
policies: prior direct source lookup then TAPEX
first four-digit year in first table scan for questions requesting a year as sanity
flat range executor (if exposed), else keep prior direct answer + TAPEX
strong direct hierarchical executor, else prior direct + TAPEX
same candidates, discriminator; else prior direct + TAPEX
primary_metric: Value exact normalized as previously. Paired rescue, harm, output coverage, cluster bootstrap over table_uid for differences. Returning an answer matches prior comparator even if spelling-only case variation.
blinded_annotation: 30 hash-selected per predetermined prefix; two same-system model readings of raw grid without gold or model predictions; no independent humans. Coordinates zero-based. Keep conditional and ambiguous cases.
stress: Before seeing scores use same 30 for masked manual challenge design. Header-swap paired check: for unambiguous, simple numeric years across 2 or 3 distinct columns, exchange winning year label with one competitor label (date strings travel with label); positive target changes, full column exchange as invariant; new predictions without gold or membership. Additional eight matched questions on differing financial range/attribute. All artificial edits exploratory; never part of natural overall score.
decision: if added scope challenge does not independently beat strong direct evaluator, do not credit improvement to challenger. No testing-set adaptation. No SOTA or all financial statements claim.
